overall_goal: Clear the food processor, weigh ingredients, and prepare to cook the chocolate sauce

goals.description: Disassemble the food processor and clear biscuit crumbs from its parts
goals.rationale: The person takes apart the food processor and shakes the lid, blade, and bowl to collect all the crushed biscuit crumbs.

goals.description: Measure and transfer crushed biscuits into a bowl
goals.rationale: The person uses a glass to measure the crushed biscuits from the food processor bowl and pours them into a larger bowl.

goals.description: Check and move the carrot soup pot
goals.rationale: The person briefly checks the carrot soup and moves the pot to free up a burner on the hob.

goals.description: Retrieve a pot for making chocolate sauce
goals.rationale: The person searches the cupboard and selects a pot to use for cooking the chocolate sauce.

goals.description: Retrieve a clean wooden spoon from the dishwasher
goals.rationale: The person opens the dishwasher to get a clean wooden spoon and places it on the countertop.

goals.description: Retrieve a tupperware container for weighing ingredients
goals.rationale: The person searches the cupboards and extracts a tupperware container from inside a pot to use for weighing.

goals.description: Prepare the scale and notepad for logging ingredient weights
goals.rationale: The person turns on the scale, clears the notepad, and writes down the recipe ingredients to prepare for weighing.

goals.description: Weigh the crushed biscuits and log the measurement
goals.rationale: The person pours the crushed biscuits into the tupperware on the scale, writes down the weight, and returns the biscuits to the bowl.

goals.description: Prepare the butter and scale for weighing
goals.rationale: The person retrieves and partially unwraps the butter, then writes it on the notepad and places a pot on the scale.

goals.description: Cut and weigh the butter, then store the rest
goals.rationale: The person cuts a portion of the butter into the pot on the scale and wraps the remaining butter to put back in the fridge.

goals.description: Start melting the butter and gather remaining ingredients and tools
goals.rationale: The person moves the pot with butter to the hob, turns on the burner, and gathers cocoa, condensed milk, and a spoon.
